items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: I had the same couple of players... And Willie James on classical saxophone.

ctx.x: No, no. He sang horn playing with Willie James.
That's what, when I had my old man. Yeah. That's what my old man, Willie James. Are you speaking about Amos Rowley?
Old man Dutre. Dutre playing with him, yeah.

items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: We went there behind Pajon and Willie, or that girl, what do you mean? Yeah. Uh, Willoughbend. Yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. Willoughbend. Yeah. Pajon, they played with their boys. They didn't play too long, and I'll tell you who they had, this boy would die, and they climbed the sax. Henry. Henry. From your line of your way. Henry. You remember him? Yeah. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry Julian. Henry…
I was gonna ask you about the advertising job. You say you played advertising jobs. Who did you play? What band did you play with?
